style: Hand-inked map illustration for a parchment adventure map of an original high-fantasy realm. Flat single-color dark sepia ink (#3E3022) with slightly rough brush edges, like a stamp or woodcut printed on old paper. No other colors, no gradients, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers. Transparent background unless stated otherwise. Original design, do not imitate existing games.

assets.prompt: A vertical strip of old warm tan parchment paper (#D8C49A to #C2A979, subtle darker age stains and foxing), filling the full height edge to edge with NO top or bottom border so it can tile vertically. Along the LEFT and RIGHT margins only, very faint faded sepia hand-drawn old-map sketches: tiny pine forests, rounded hills, a few small mountain peaks, a winding river fragment and one or two tiny tower ruins, drawn lightly like a cartographer's illustration and fading out toward the center. The central 60 percent stays almost blank, calm and low contrast (map nodes will be drawn there). The LEFT and RIGHT edges are torn and irregular with a few dark ink splatters near the edges; outside the torn edges is fully transparent. No text, no compass, no labels. This is an exception to the single sepia color rule: use the parchment colors described.
A small round stone golem head icon with a single narrow eye slit, a mossy crack across its brow and a tiny fern sprouting on top, front view, compact and bold.
A fierce horned stone golem skull icon with heavy bronze jaw plates, a cracked brow and two narrow angry eye slits, bolder and more menacing than a normal enemy, front view.
A bold question mark drawn inside a round coin-like disc, thick brush stroke.
A merchant icon: a tied coin sack with a few coins spilling out beside it.
A small closed treasure chest icon, side-front view, with a metal band and lock.
A campfire icon with three flames above crossed logs.
A big menacing cauldron-golem face icon: a round stone-and-bronze cauldron head with a cracked glass dome on top, handle loops at its sides and an arched hatch for a mouth, framed by a spiky ring.

assets.brief: boss illustration at the top of the map
assets.prompt: A large ink illustration of the act boss 'Brood Cauldron': a massive egg-shaped stone-and-bronze cauldron golem with a cracked glass dome on top, handle loops like proud hips, an arched belly hatch with two little pebble golems peeking out, and two huge stone feet, standing on a curling cloud of mist and ivy. Drawn in the single sepia ink with light hatching, like an illustration printed on a map. Front view, centered.

assets.brief: single starting point (the Ancient) at the bottom of the map
assets.prompt: A round emblem marking the single starting point of the journey: a small coiled dragon wrapped around a single upward flame inside a circular ring of thorny leaves, like an old wax-seal stamp. Original design, no letters. Bold, centered, front view.
